name: Seagrow Caves
description: Sea caves at the base of a two-hundred-foot cliff of dark gray stone. A swirling slick of colors dances on the water's surface, emanating from the cave. Home to myconids; linked to Sharruth's grave and the Elemental Plane of Fire.
itemsOfInterest: B2 Fungus Farm — sprouts & violet fungi
B6 Crystal Cave — fire-plane link, sulfur smell
notes:
Reach by rowboat (5 mi, ~3 hr 20 min) or coastal walk (7 mi, ~2 hr 20 min).

Tides: Low midnight–sunrise & noon–sunset; High sunrise–noon & sunset–midnight.

DC 20 Charisma to parley with myconids; Tarak mention = advantage.
